notes: Theme "terminal" (the first-run default; the terminal palette: accent fg 12). Scratch HOME: ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json {modelProvider:"gemini", theme, trustedWorkspaces} and cache/onboarding.json done; GEMINI_API_KEY, no login. Input box: "> " between two ──── borders, long input word-wrapped by agy onto rows indented two spaces; no placeholder. The slash menu is below the box: "> /name" marks the highlighted item (also in the accent colour), others "  /name"; fuzzy ("/sum" highlights /resume); "/new" shows "/clear (new)". Tab completes the highlighted item and closes the menu. No /compact (No matches). Esc closes the menu and keeps the input. Re-captured from 1.3.3 (2026-10-10) the same way, cache/onboarding.json marked complete (consumerOnboardingComplete, onboardingComplete): every state, one fresh launch each, OSC 11 answered as a dark terminal.
